void.$description: Void — Deepest canvas — the void behind everything, visible at the absolute darkest page edges

midnight-canvas.$description: Midnight Canvas — Primary page background — the dominant surface where all content lives

carbon.$description: Carbon — Subtle surface lift for embedded app screenshots and elevated content blocks

graphite.$description: Graphite — List and card surface — the faintest step up from canvas for grouped content

pure-white.$description: Pure White — Primary text, headings, icons — maximum contrast against the dark canvas

ash.$description: Ash — Secondary text and icon fills at reduced opacity contexts

smoke.$description: Smoke — Muted body text and supporting copy

dim.$description: Dim — Tertiary text — captions, metadata, timestamps

fog.$description: Fog — Supporting neutral for secondary UI, dividers, and muted labels. Do not promote it to the primary CTA color

pewter.$description: Pewter — Deepest text level — placeholder, disabled, very-low-emphasis body

silver.$description: Silver — Heading color at reduced emphasis — sub-section titles, subdued headers

signal-violet.$description: Signal Violet — Primary brand violet — the signature color saturating hero backgrounds, app icons, and brand surfaces

glow-violet.$description: Glow Violet — Violet supporting accent for decorative details and low-frequency emphasis. Do not promote it to the primary CTA color

pulse-violet.$description: Pulse Violet — Mid-violet for feature headings and emphasis — sits between Signal Violet and Glow Violet in the scale

deep-violet.$description: Deep Violet — Dark violet for pressed link states and deep accent contexts

twilight-violet.$description: Twilight Violet — Violet supporting accent for decorative details and low-frequency emphasis. Do not promote it to the primary CTA color

lilac-mist.$description: Lilac Mist — Soft violet for muted text and subtle border accents where full saturation would shout

periwinkle.$description: Periwinkle — Cool violet tint for body text and light border treatment — the coolest end of the violet range

neon-green.$description: Neon Green — Accent green for select feature headings — functional punctuation that breaks the violet monotony

alarm-red.$description: Alarm Red — Notification badges, unread indicators, and attention-grabbing icon accents

aurora-gradient.$description: Aurora Gradient — Signature hero and brand gradient — blue to magenta sweep used on logo, feature icons, and brand surfaces

apple-system.$description: Universal system stack serving all text from body copy through display headings. Weight 300 is used for large display headings to create an airy, premium feel; weight 400 for body; weight 500 for subheadings and navigation; weight 600 for feature names and labels. The system-font-only choice is deliberate — it signals native Apple heritage, ensures zero font-loading delay, and matches the product's iOS-first identity.
